about: Checks tifxyz scroll-surface flattenings for distortion, fold-overs and collapse, and re-flattens with SLIM or ARAP.
about_note: Not set on GitHub: no tool here can edit the repository About field; the owner sets it in the repository settings (gear icon next to About).
summary: (1) Data: public PHerc0139 organizer tifxyz meshes (9.362 um; study also 2.399 um) and small PHerc0800/PHerc1447 meshes (8.64 um), geometry only. (2) Letters are read from the flattened surface; flatcheck measures per quad whether the flattening preserves true length (+-5 %), flags fold-overs and collapsed ABF++ maps, shows intrinsic curvature, and re-flattens with SLIM/ARAP, so entrants see where letters will be stretched before rendering. (3) A standard, tested isometry check for tifxyz, plus a scan for the worst windows of a mesh. (4) 21 tests pass; scripts/reproduce.sh reproduces on three public meshes: the grid flattening fails 93.1 % whole-mesh (90.05-92.94 %), and no method reaches it in the most curved windows. Earlier study: ABF++ 0/10, SLIM 3/10, ARAP 4/10 hard windows; SLIM >= ABF++ in 33/33.
